final: SELECT AVG(item_ratio) AS overall_average_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_order_item FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CAST(ili.product_price AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id)
